caseNameFull: Alexander Alexandervi BISTRIKA v. OREGON and Svetlana Alexandrovna Bistrika v. Oregon.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioners allowed until May 18, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
